title: Google Local Services Ads Scraper input
description: Get the public Google Local Services advertiser list for supported service categories in a United States city or district. This Actor returns public advertiser-card data only; it does not access private Google Ads accounts, consumer lead messages, or campaign budgets.

queries.title: Local Services categories
queries.description: One to ten supported Local Services category queries, for example ["electrician", "plumber"]. Enter the service only; set the market separately with locationName and dataCid. Each completed category and city-CID request is billed once.

locationName.title: City or district label
locationName.description: Caller-provided readable label for the same United States city or district represented by dataCid, for example "Austin, Texas, United States". dataCid is the authoritative provider market selector; this matching label is carried into every output record for CRM and agent workflows.

dataCid.title: Google city or district CID
dataCid.description: Required decimal Google CID for the requested city or district, not a business CID or a Google Place ID. Use it exactly as a string to preserve all digits. Example: Austin, Texas is "6745062158417646970". The Actor validates it so it never substitutes a different market.

maxResults.title: Maximum advertisers per category
maxResults.description: Maximum public advertiser records to save for each category query. The dedicated source can return up to 20 cards per category; this cap controls dataset size, not the number of billed category queries.

languageCode.title: Google interface language
languageCode.description: Two-to-five-letter Google interface language code, such as "en" or "es". It defaults to en and is included in the provider request.

countryCode.title: Country
countryCode.description: The dedicated Google Local Services provider source currently supports United States city and district CIDs. Keep this set to us.

jobType.title: Optional job type
jobType.description: Optional supported Local Services job-type identifier, for example "restore_power" with electrician. Leave blank to collect the category-level advertiser list. The same job type applies to all queries in this run.
